app.title: musicline – a music party game
app.description: Gather your crew, listen to a song clip and build your musical timeline.
app.footer: A music party game powered by Nuxt UI and YouTube.

start.heading: Play musicline
start.subtitle: Create a room for your friends or join a game with the host's code. No account, no sign-in.
start.createDescription: Become the host, set the rules and invite the other players with a QR code.
start.joinDescription: Enter the 4-digit code from the host or scan their QR code.

create.title: Create a room
create.subtitle: Enter your nickname and set the game rules. We will generate the room code and QR code for you.
create.noAccount: No account needed — your nickname is stored in a cookie.
create.settingsHint: The host can only change these when creating the room.
create.categoryError: The selected category does not exist. Refresh the page and try again.
create.categoriesUnavailable: Could not load categories. You can still play with all songs.

join.title: Join a room
join.subtitle: Enter your nickname and the room code. You can also scan the host's QR code.
join.notFound: No room found with that code. Check the code and try again.
join.full: This room is full. Ask the host to create a new one.
join.invalidQr: This is not a Hitster room QR code.

validation.playerName: The nickname must be between 2 and 20 characters.
validation.roomCode: The room code must have exactly 4 digits.

room.createdSubtitle: Invite your friends with the code or QR code. The game starts soon.
room.joinedSubtitle: You are in the room. Wait for the host to start the game.
room.copyError: Could not copy the room code.
room.qrHint: Scan the code with a phone to join the room.
room.notFoundHint: The code is invalid or the room has expired. Ask the host for a new code.
room.noSession: You are not in this room
room.noSessionHint: You can join the room by entering your nickname.
room.startHint: You can start right away — more players can join mid-game.
room.waitingForHost: Wait for the host to start the game.
room.waitingHostTitle: The host has not started yet
room.waitingHostHint: Look around the room. The board and round will appear automatically.
room.previewHint: Tap a player to preview their timeline
room.emptyTimelineHint: A starting card appears when the game begins.
room.timelineDrawerHint: Your cards, tokens and current progress.
room.knowSongHint: Tap as soon as the clip starts. The host will see your claim.
room.knowSongClaimedHint: The host can see your claim. After the clip, say the artist and title.
room.knowSongSentHint: The host can see that you know the song.
room.claimsListHostHint: The active player is always first. Award tokens to players who correctly named the artist and title.
room.claimsListGuestHint: The active player is always first. The host awards tokens for correct answers.
room.claimsAwardHint: You can award at most one token to each person in this round.
room.claimsWaitingHostHint: The host awards tokens for correct answers.
room.activePlayerCannotClaimHint: You cannot claim the song — pick a slot on the timeline and the host will reveal the answer after the clip.
room.leaveConfirmHint: Leaving the game removes you from the player list. You will not be able to return with the same card.
room.placeCardHint: Tap the plus between cards to show where the song belongs, then confirm your choice.
room.placeCardSpectatorHint: The host will see the chosen slot after the player confirms it.
room.placementConfirmedHint: The host can now reveal the song and check the answer.
room.placementSentHint: The host can now reveal the song.
room.placeSelectHint: Slot {position} selected. Confirm to lock it in.
room.placeSelectEmpty: Pick one of the slots on the timeline.
room.tokensHint: Players take turns naming the artist and title. Award a token for every correct answer.
room.tokenAwardedHint: {name} receives a token for the answer.
room.tokenBoardHint: You have {count} token(s). Pick a slot on the active player's timeline — on a collision the closest year wins.
room.tokenBoardActivePlayerHint: This is your timeline. Other players can bet tokens on your slot.
room.tokenBoardNoTokens: You have no tokens. You can bet once you earn one.
room.tokenBoardRevealedHint: The round is resolved — check the token results.
room.tokenBoardSpendHint: The token is lost if the slot is wrong. A correct slot wins the card.
room.tokenPlacedHint: Your token is on slot {position}. Waiting for the reveal.
room.tokenResultCardAndToken: {name} wins the card and a token.
room.tokenYearHint: Two tokens share the same slot. Enter the song's release year. The closest year wins; on a tie the token placed earlier wins.
room.tokenYearSubmittedHint: The host can reveal the song now.
room.clipFinishedHost: Clip finished — waiting for the player to pick a slot.
room.clipFinishedPlacedHost: Slot confirmed — you can reveal the song.
room.noTokensHint: No token was awarded in this round. Move on to the next player?
room.hostDrawInfo: As the host you draw songs, reveal the answer after the slot is confirmed and award tokens for correct guesses. A correct slot adds the card automatically.
room.winnerHint: {name} collected the required number of cards.
room.lateJoinHint: New players can join with the code or QR code.
room.drawHintHost: Draw a song and start the clip.
room.waitingForHostDraw: The host will draw a song shortly.
room.listenHintHost: Listen carefully. After the clip the player picks a slot, then you reveal the song.
room.listenHintGuest: The clip is playing. Listen and claim if you know the song.
room.yourTurnHint: Pick a slot on your timeline and confirm. The host will then reveal the song.
room.revealReadyHint: Slot confirmed — you can reveal the song.
room.hostWaitingPlacementHint: Waiting for {name} to confirm a slot.
room.waitingPlacementHint: Waiting for {name} to confirm a slot.
room.revealHint: The host revealed the answer. Check the slot and year.
room.revealHintHost: Answer visible. The card is added only for a correct slot. Award tokens, then move on.
room.scoredHint: Card added to the timeline. The host moves to the next player.
room.stageIdleHost: Press “Draw a song” to start a round.
room.stageIdleGuest: Waiting for the host to draw a song.
room.stageGuessing: Clip finished — {name} is picking a slot while everyone guesses the artist and title.
room.stagePlacementConfirmed: {name} confirmed a slot. The host can reveal the song.
room.footerRevealHost: The player confirmed a slot. You can reveal the song.
room.footerRevealGuest: Slot confirmed. The host will reveal the song shortly.
room.footerWaitingPlacement: Waiting for {name} to pick a slot. Then you can reveal the song.
room.footerWaitingPlacementGuest: Waiting for {name} to confirm a slot.
room.footerRevealHint: The card is added only for a correct slot. Award tokens, then move on.
room.footerScoredHint: Card added. Move on to the next player.
room.gameStartedHint: Every player gets a starting card and starts with no tokens. The host begins the first round.

play.title: Guess the song
play.subtitle: Listen to a 15-second clip and guess the title, artist and release year.
play.clipHint: The clip stops automatically after {seconds} seconds.
play.emptyAnswer: Draw a song to see the answer here.
play.listenHint: Listen carefully — the answer appears automatically after {seconds} seconds.
play.playerPlaceholder: The player appears after you draw a song.

admin.title: Song import
admin.subtitle: Paste the songs as JSON. The import is idempotent — existing songs are updated.
admin.deniedHint: This view only works with a valid ?secret=… parameter in the URL.
admin.formHint: Supported format: an array of songs or an object with a "songs" field. youtubeId is optional — the server resolves embeddable audio on first play.

scanner.description: Point the camera at the room QR code.
scanner.unsupported: This browser does not support camera scanning.
